prompts.spectre: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent modular sprite sheet for a top-down industrial mech game. Original detailed pre-rendered industrial sci-fi sprites, Factorio-like material realism but no copied designs. Fixed orthographic camera 55 degrees above ground, looking north, fixed upper-left light. EXACT grid: 8 columns and 5 equal-height rows, all cells same size with transparent gutters. Desired image 2048 by 1280. Columns in order: mech facing DOWN (south/front), DOWN-LEFT (southwest), LEFT (west/profile), UP-LEFT (northwest/back three-quarter), UP (north/back), UP-RIGHT (northeast), RIGHT (east/profile), DOWN-RIGHT (southeast). Actual distinct camera views of same 3D object, NOT flat rotated pictures. ROW 1: isolated UPPER BODY ONLY (cockpit, shoulders, short arms, compact gun on its right arm, back machinery), no legs. Its waist connector ends exactly at center of each cell; upper body extends above it. ROW 2: isolated LOWER BODY ONLY (pelvis and two mechanical legs), neutral planted stance. Pelvis connector exactly at cell center, legs extend below it. ROW 3: same LOWER BODY ONLY, left foot forward/right foot back. ROW 4: same LOWER BODY ONLY, legs passing at mid-stride with one knee raised. ROW 5: same LOWER BODY ONLY, right foot forward/left foot back. Each row is exactly eight complete isolated pieces. All pieces same scale, all pivots at cell center, padding at least 10% per cell. No torso on rows 2-5; no legs on row 1. Upper and lower pieces will be composited at the identical pivot. Sharp readable silhouettes at small scale; fine wear, seams, pistons, cast metal. No text, labels, borders, gridlines, platform, ground, cast shadows or background. Real transparent alpha. Subject: MR-07 Spectre: agile olive-drab scout mech, slim compact torso, small cyan visor, dark exposed metal joints, slender digitigrade legs, restrained orange warning marks.
